title: Capitalization Table
description: A company's capitalization table: who holds which shares of each class, with ownership percentages and fully diluted totals.

company_name.description: Name of the company whose capitalization is shown, from the title block.

table_basis.description: Whether the table shows current capitalization or a pro forma (post-financing) view, as stated under the title, e.g. 'Pro-Forma' or 'Current'.

share_classes.description: The share classes that have their own share-count column, in column order (e.g. Common Stock, Series A, Series B).

items.description: Share class name as printed in the column header, without footnote markers.

holders.description: One entry per holder row (investors, founders, and option pool rows), in table order. Exclude section headings and the totals row.

holder_name.description: Holder or row name, e.g. 'Investor #1' or 'Granted Option Shares'.

holder_group.description: Section heading the row sits under, e.g. 'Investors', 'Founders', or the equity incentive plan name.

common_shares.description: Common Stock shares. 0 when the cell shows a dash.

series_a_shares.description: Series A Preferred shares. 0 when the cell shows a dash.

series_b_shares.description: Series B Preferred shares. 0 when the cell shows a dash.

total_shares.description: Total shares held across all classes (fully diluted).

total_percent.description: Fully diluted ownership percentage, as a number of percent (8.3 for 8.3%).

totals.description: The totals row at the bottom of the table.

total_common_shares.description: Total Common Stock shares, including option pool rows.

fully_diluted_shares.description: Total shares across all classes: the fully diluted share count.

option_pool_increase_shares.description: Shares added to the option pool in this financing (the 'Available Option Shares (Increase)' row), if shown.

conversion_assumption.description: The footnote stating the assumed conversion ratio of preferred into common stock, quoted briefly.
